user.title: Dial Timer
user.description: Choose the entity to control. Setting a duration turns it on, and it turns off automatically when the time is up.

error.invalid_entity: Please choose a switch, light, fan, climate or input_boolean entity.

abort.already_configured: This entity already has a timer.

schedule.name: Schedule timer
schedule.description: Turns the controlled entity on at a later time for a number of minutes.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to keep it on, in minutes.

start_in.name: Start in
start_in.description: Minutes from now until it turns on. Leave out to start now.

start_at.name: Start at
start_at.description: Date and time to turn it on. Use instead of Start in.

extend.name: Extend timer
extend.description: Adds minutes to the running or scheduled timer, to the second. Use negative minutes to shorten it. Without a timer, positive minutes start one.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Minutes to add. Negative minutes take time away; if no time is left, the controlled entity turns off.
